title: Warm Sweet French Fenugreek Tart
description: A Normandy inspired dessert featuring fenugreek and candy, this tart is perfect for those looking for a dairy free friendly French treat. The combination of resinous fenugreek and sweet candy creates a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, grind the soaked fenugreek seeds into a fine paste.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, confectioners sugar, and salt.
Add the coconut oil, vanilla extract, and fenugreek paste to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it in a tart pan.
Arrange the candy pieces on top of the dough in a pattern.
Bake the tart for 35 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the tart warm and enjoy.
